traceability.evidence:
Story file: - docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md exists with the described requirements and references branch-level annotation validation.
Rule implementation: - src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts - Defines an ESLint RuleModule named implicitly via default export. - JSDoc header: - @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION - @req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE - meta: - type: "problem" - docs.description: "Require @story and @req annotations on code branches" - fixable: "code" - messages.missingAnnotation: "Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}." (clear, annotation-specific message) - schema: options object with optional `branchTypes: string[]`, uniqueItems, no additionalProperties. - create(context): - Calls validateBranchTypes(context) from ../utils/branch-annotation-helpers. - If the result is not an array, returns it directly (used for invalid config listener). - Otherwise iterates branchTypes and registers handlers for each AST node type: - For each type, handler calls reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef). - For SwitchCase, skips default case via `if (type === "SwitchCase" && (node as any).test == null) return;`, aligning with significance criteria.
Branch utilities and requirements: - src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES (covers REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION and REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA): - ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"] - Matches the story’s specified significant branches: if/else, try/catch, switch, loops. - validateBranchTypes(context) (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE + invalid config behavior): - Reads options[0].branchTypes. - If branchTypes is an array: - Filters out invalid types not in DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - If invalidTypes.length > 0: - Returns { Program: ProgramHandler }. - ProgramHandler reports for each invalid type with message: `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}`. - This matches the invalid-configuration message shape described in the story. - If all valid, returns the custom branchTypes array. - If branchTypes is not provided, returns Array.from(DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES). - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node) (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION): - For SwitchCase: - Uses sourceCode.lines and PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET to scan lines above the case, collecting leading // or /* comments via a while loop. - Handles cases where comments are separated by a blank line within the configured offset. - For other nodes: - Uses sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node) and maps comment.value, joined into a single string. - Provides the raw text used for @story/@req parsing. - getBranchAnnotationInfo(...) (internal, REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING): - Uses gatherBranchCommentText to get text. - Computes: - missingStory = !/@story\b/.test(text) - missingReq = !/@req\b/.test(text) - indent from the line’s leading whitespace. - insertPos via sourceCode.getIndexFromLoc at (branch start line, column 0). - reportMissingStory(...) and reportMissingReq(...) (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, User Experience): - Both use context.report with messageId "missingAnnotation" and data { missing: "@story" | "@req" }. - Offer auto-fixes: - Insert `// @story .story.md` above the branch (only once per file via storyFixCountRef). - Insert `// @req ` above the branch when appropriate. - When fixes are not offered (e.g., subsequent missing @story or when missingStory is also true for @req), they still report a clear error without a fixer. - reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef): - Calls getBranchAnnotationInfo. - Builds an actions array for story and req with their missing flags and handlers. - Iterates actions.forEach, calling the appropriate report function when missing. - Works for any branch node passed in, so nested and complex control flow is naturally handled.
Plugin integration: - src/index.ts - RULE_NAMES includes "require-branch-annotation". - Dynamic loader requires ./rules/${name} and sets rules[name] = mod.default ?? mod. - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES maps: - "traceability/require-branch-annotation": "error". - configs.recommended and configs.strict both use createTraceabilityFlatConfig(), which sets the plugin rules with those severities, thus integrating this rule into the recommended/strict presets.
Tests for the rule (behavior and edge cases): - tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts - Header explicitly links to the story: - Tests for: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION and error-related requirements. - Uses eslint RuleTester with ecmaVersion 2020. - Valid cases: - IfStatement with preceding line comments containing @story and @req. - ForStatement with block comments containing @story and @req. - SwitchCase with annotations immediately before the case. - SwitchCase where an annotated comment line is two lines above (with a blank line in between), verifying fallback comment scanning. - Try/finally annotated before try. - CatchClause annotated separately. - DoWhile, ForOf, ForIn, While loops, each with proper annotations. - Default case without annotations treated as valid (shows deliberate significance criteria for cases): `valid default case without annotations`. - Custom branchTypes configurations verifying configurable scope: - branchTypes: ["IfStatement"] -> switch code is ignored (no errors). - branchTypes: ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase"] -> annotated if is valid. - Invalid cases: - Missing annotations on IfStatement: - Code: `if (condition) {}`. - Expected output: inserts `// @story .story.md` above the if. - Errors: two missingAnnotation reports (for @story and @req). - Missing @req on ForStatement when only @story present, with fixer inserting `// @req `. - Missing @story on WhileStatement when only @req present, with fixer inserting `// @story .story.md`. - Missing annotations on SwitchCase (including with blank line): - Expected outputs insert `// @story .story.md` before case. - Errors include missingAnnotation for @story and @req. - Missing annotations on DoWhile, ForOf, ForIn loops. - Missing annotations on try-catch blocks where both try and catch branches are enforced, with four errors (two per branch: @story and @req). - Configurable scope enforcement: - branchTypes: ["ForStatement"] with a for loop lacking annotations -> fixer inserts @story and reports both @story and @req missing. - Invalid configuration test: - options: [{ branchTypes: ["UnknownType"] }]. - Expects an error with message matching `/should be equal to one of the allowed values/`, validating validateBranchTypes invalid-type behavior.
Tests for configuration helper: - tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts - Header: - Tests for: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - validateBranchTypes tests: - No options: returns DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - Valid options: [{ branchTypes: ["IfStatement", "ForStatement"] }] -> returns that array exactly. - Invalid options: [{ branchTypes: ["UnknownType", "Foo"] }]: - Returns an object with a Program property. - Calling Program(fakeNode) triggers context.report twice, once per invalid type, with messages containing `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values:`.
Documentation for the rule: - docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md - References this story and requirements: - @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - @req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION - @req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - Describes intent: "Ensures that significant code branches (if/else, switch cases, loops, try/catch) have `@story` and `@req` annotations for traceability." - Details: - Describes comment-based detection for branches. - Documents options.branchTypes, its default (matching DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES) and allowed values. - Includes example configuration snippets in .eslintrc.js. - Examples: - Correct code with @story and @req before an if block. - Incorrect code missing annotations. - Invalid configuration example with InvalidType in branchTypes, and the resulting error message format matches the implementation.
Test execution: - Command executed via tool: - `npm test -- --verbose --runInBand` - Which runs: `jest --ci --bail --verbose --runInBand`. - The command finished without any reported test failures or stack traces in the tool output, indicating that all Jest tests, including those for require-branch-annotation and branch-annotation-helpers, are passing.
traceability.notes: This story is fully implemented. The `traceability/require-branch-annotation` ESLint rule exists, is integrated into the plugin’s rule set and recommended/strict configs, and enforces @story/@req annotations on significant code branches with configurable scope. Helper utilities cover branch detection, comment association, and annotation parsing, including handling of switch cases, loops, try/catch, and nested structures. Invalid configuration for `branchTypes` is correctly reported with descriptive messages matching the specification. Tests comprehensively cover valid and invalid branch patterns, configurable scope behavior, and invalid configuration handling. Dedicated documentation for the rule provides usage, configuration details, and examples. All tests pass under Jest, confirming the behavior. Accordingly, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are satisfied.
